The proportion of incorrect characters is denoted by \(p\), and experience has shown that \(p = 0.0001\). A particular data set from the firm contains 14500 characters, of which \(X\) characters are incorrect.

The firm's management wishes to decrease the value of \(p\) by giving their employees some training. Their aim is that, for a data set containing 14500 characters, the value of \(\mathrm{P}(X = 0)\) for the new value of \(p\) should be double the value of \(\mathrm{P}(X = 0)\) when \(p = 0.0001\).
